booking_event_id.title: Booking Event Id
booking_event_id.description: Use to connect a booking from HOSAPI to the redeem.

booking_name.title: Booking Name
booking_name.description: Name attached to booking. Only used if the event_id is given.

reservation_id.title: Reservation Id
reservation_id.description: Id for reservation to be used when redeeming, if not given, it will check if there are any existing reservations, and use that. Should be given for anonymous user.
